## What

BL-97 / REQ-WRITE-3 (deliberately minimal per the ticket's design ruling — not a Notion clone): typing `/` at a block start opens a small menu of the block-level constructs `pageSchema` actually has. Typed text filters; ArrowUp/Down + Enter insert the construct at the caret (the `/`+query is consumed — it lives inside the replaced paragraph, so one undo restores it); Escape dismisses. Mouse hover/click works; there is no palette, no toolbar, no AI entries.

## Shape

- `packages/editor/src/slash-menu.ts` — a PM plugin in the `decorationsPlugin` mold: plugin **state** derives `{from, query, dismissedFrom, active}` from the caret's `/^\/(\S*)$/` match (paragraph parents only — `code_block`/heading/table-cell caret parents can't match; caret must be at block end so apply never eats text after it). A `handleKeyDown` claims arrows/Enter/Escape **only while open**; the plugin is wired into `pagePlugins` **before** the editing keymap so its claims beat `split`, and a claimed key's preventDefault keeps the chrome's layered-Esc out via its `e.defaultPrevented` guard. `applySlashEntry` is a single `tr.replaceWith` of the `/`-paragraph by the entry's node(s) — schema-valid in one step.
- `apps/web/src/spa/slash-menu.ts` — the DOM half. The package convention is **DOM-free** (`decorations.ts`'s ruling), so the `.ui-menu` box (shared ui-* primitive classes — zero new stylesheet lines, `[data-highlighted]` active-row styling already exists) renders client-side: emitted only while the match is open, caret-positioned via `view.coordsAtPos`, re-synced through PageMount's existing `installOriginDispatch` `onTransaction` tap (covers local commits + remote ySync applies) plus capture-scroll/resize listeners.
- Entries (11): Heading 2/3, Quote, Code block, Bulleted/Numbered/Task lists, Divider, Figure, Table (2×2), Math block — every caret-insertable `group:"block"` construct; `front_matter`/`footnote_definition`/`link_definition`/`html_block` are canonical-serialization constructs, deliberately absent. Heading levels mirror the format bubble's H2/H3 vocabulary (front-matter owns the title).
- Dismissal is sticky: Escape closes and the *same* `/`-block match stays closed while typing continues (text is never eaten); the match ending re-arms the trigger.

## Contract

`data-slash-menu` + `data-slash-item` declared in `dom-contract.ts` (editor surface, conditional, emitted only while open — hook presence IS the menu-open contract).

## Tests

- `packages/editor/src/slash-menu.test.ts` — 21 PM-state legs: match arms (empty para, mid-text, caret-not-at-end, atom-leading block, code_block, heading, space-closes), filter semantics (incl. keyword-substring hits), apply node shapes (heading level, blockquote>para, task `checked:false`, atomic trailing para, 2×2 table, nested `list_item` parent + `doc.check()`), dismiss-sticky/re-arm, move/set meta, collab-state mounting.
- `apps/web/src/spa/slash-menu.dom.test.tsx` — 9 happy-dom legs on a real `EditorView` + real PM keydown: emit-only-while-open, one row per `SLASH_ENTRIES`, typed filtering + empty state, Enter insert through the keyboard path, ArrowDown+Enter second row, Escape (text kept, stays dismissed), delete-`/` closes, read-only mount + code-block arms, and the PageMount production-seam leg.
